original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Complete the explicitly requested PR3605 public full wrapper with a fresh retained bootstrap and preserve a bounded source-bound execution transcript.
scope_change_reason: The live handoff takes precedence over a new task draw. Refine the portable replay concern to the previously unexecuted full wrapper path; this is execution coverage, not a newly found environment defect or a construction search.
bottleneck_link: An unexecuted public full wrapper leaves the finite source/native/owner/physical/prefix/outer release path untested as a complete reproducible workflow.
stop_rule: Run the exact public wrapper once with jobs1, no external retained cache and no prepare-only shortcut; preserve failures and do not retry a long run automatically. Stop after receipt/source review and bounded transcript controls; do not change frozen source or all-size claims.
evidence: The exact PR3605 full public wrapper exited 0 in 2443.538549916 seconds with no external retained-cache input. All 18 top-level stages, four fresh bootstrap native chains, 16 fresh parent stages, two changed native chains, seven admission stages and six independent stages passed. All 157 supplied source/input files were unchanged. The 214-member archive authenticates the retained transcript; the local collector checked all omitted source/cache/generated bytes and restored all four historical JSON hashes. Registered normal and optimized checks pass 15 semantic rejection controls. No new endpoint or all-size theorem is claimed.
